messages.text: At 16¢ that's about $75 a month in power for the 40T, on $799 up front. It draws for a full block every ten minutes, year after year, and stacks sats meanwhile. First miner, or adding to a setup?

Then the 40T is a good first machine — best value per TH we sell, one box, plug in, point it at a pool and you're running a real piece of the network you can watch and show people.

$799, Batch 6, ships November 21, 2026. Where would it sit — desk or garage?

context.pop: At 10¢ the Magic Miner 40T runs about $47 a month, at 16¢ about $75 — what do you pay for power?
